name: Hive'Zora
summary: Across western Silithus, Hive'Zora's silithid swarm spreads through the sands. It is one of three great hives in the desert, and its aggressive castes press outward.

sections.title: The Western Swarm
sections.body: Stone spires rise from Hive'Zora's sands in western Silithus. Porous mounds mark entrances to deep tunnels carved by silithid burrowers. Waywatchers and reavers patrol the perimeter. Below, tunnelers and hive sisters brood. The Cenarion Circle and other scouts watch as the silithid menace presses into this ancient frontier.

faq.answer: Hive'Zora's surface spires lead into a vast network of tunnels beneath western Silithus.

aliases: what monsters are in hive zora
faq.answer: Silithid castes fill Hive'Zora. Waywatchers patrol outside, heavy reavers defend the ground, tunnelers excavate below, and venomous hive sisters dwell within.

faq.q: Why is the Cenarion Circle investigating this hive?
faq.answer: Scouts and researchers in Silithus watch Hive'Zora to track the silithid threat's growth and movement. Envoys study silithid behavior, decipher their glyphs, and thin their growing numbers before the swarm overwhelms the region.

faq.q: How does Hive'Zora differ from the other hives in Silithus?
faq.answer: Hive'Zora lies farthest west among the three great hives. Hive'Ashi anchors the north, while Hive'Regal dominates the south. Each has its own brood, and all seek to spread across the desert.

angles.text: As a Druid of the Cenarion Circle, you see Hive'Zora's surge as unnatural, disrupting the desert wilds' natural balance.
As a miner, you may find rich thorium veins and rare ooze-covered mineral deposits in the twisted tunnels and around silithid colonies like Hive'Zora.
